$comment: The shape of a curation manifest for pnpm curate:pilot -- --manifest <path>. A real manifest names people by email, so it is private and is not in the repository. Every $comment is ignored.

retire.$comment: Set retiredAt on each row found by slug. A slug that is not found is reported and skipped. A retired row keeps its slug, so a study below may not reuse one retired here.

communities.$comment: Created by slug when absent. Each member is added by email when they have no live episode; an existing member is left as they are. addedAt is now when absent, a date or a date-time with its offset, or first-act-2025, the person's earliest definition, comment or vote of 2025.
communities.title: Metadata Research Center
communities.description: The research group running the pilot.

collections.$comment: Created by slug when absent, curated. Each term is asserted as a member when it is not one already. terms is a list of term texts, matched case-insensitively, or every term created before a date.
collections.title: MRC pilot terms
collections.description: The four terms the pilot walks.

studies.$comment: Created by slug when absent, over a community and a collection named above or already in the database. walkthrough generates the steps as the steward's Generate button does, only while the study has none: questions is default for the two closing questions, or a list of { prompt, responseKind } with responseKind text or scale. A study that has already closed gets no walkthrough.
studies.title: MRC pilot
studies.welcome: A walk through four terms of the 2025 list, to rehearse the protocol before the second ID4 study.

studies.$comment: A study over its past window records what happened then: it is created closed, with no walkthrough.
studies.title: ID4 study, 2025
